scope: Substantive atlas documentation and bounded primary-source research; no runtime implementation, task evidence admission, code acceptance or finding closure.
architecture_boundary: Earlier approved SDD changes remain in force; this wave changes no system-design-decisions or product files. Existing 26 editorial families remain open navigation, not an exhaustive ontology.
delegation: One level; root sole tracked writer; researchers wrote only assigned ignored scratch; independent reviewers did not author the records.
review_corrections: AF formula grounded in selected OPHI primary chapter; normalized censored sum, nonempty population and q=0/A-undefined case explicit.
Hypothetical objectives, weights, probabilities and thresholds remain allowed in conditional candidate analysis; adoption/actual action requirements do not become search stops.
Protective response separated from causal diagnosis and authority; W5-K03/K04 do not choose withheld WP-04–WP-08 action rules; stakes and reversibility remain relevant.
Cochrane Chapter10 given a specific source card; Chapters5/6 remain explicitly related sections already listed in the reused Handbook card; stale companion pointer corrected.
Actual Myerson and DAPP full-text access locations recorded; DOI/PMC relation explicit for the health-access paper.
UN SDG11.2.1 template format v1.1 distinguished from indicator-method version; ecological coefficients and ONS linkage counterexample checked against primary/official text.
SNA Chapter34 claim separated from generic landing-page card, bound to exact V11 update resource and selected D.3 paragraphs; revision markup and unverified final-edition equivalence explicit.
Numeric zero separated from absence while allowing rounding; source/template identity and method validity remain separate.
Constructed loss/regret example checked independently; arbitrary scenario frequencies remain distinct from probabilities; outside inputs distinguished from derived analysis.
root_review: Reviewed every new ground, all new source cards and source bindings; independently opened selected OPHI, UNDP, ONS, Robinson, Cochrane, RAND and UNSD primary materials. Reviewed and resolved independent critique. No claim of reading every complete work or surveying all later literature.

checks.scope: Finite documentation checks only; product tests/builds/imports/install/data processing not run.

remaining_limits: These sources describe bounded methods, propositions and acquisition routes; local datasets, rights, institutional acts, response parameters and mandates are not supplied by atlas prose.
Selected-text, abstract/metadata and indexed-extract access are distinguished per source and ground. Historical SDMX and revision-marked SNA examples need live provider/version reconciliation.
No external payload snapshots or content digests retained; research URLs and versions do not constitute admitted immutable evidence.
No new family is required by the reviewed additions; completeness of families, literature, current law or actual task inputs is not established.
Full reviewer notes remain local ignored files, cited by digest; substantive corrections and scope are recorded here. Previous receipts describe previous versions.
independent_review_result: Scoped source/quantitative/authority review and final SNA delta resolved; no remaining actionable issue reported in new records. Not a full-atlas or runtime audit.
